completeProposedProcedure.NEW_application: One willing perceived creature including self;60elapsed seconds, no concentration. No RP-pool prerequisite for learning a quote. One active record per beneficiary. No arbitrary rank/query-count cap; while operative the beneficiary can form one precisely specified inquiry at a time without an Action, only during a genuine decision window, never interrupting an indivisible transaction. Responses are private to beneficiary.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_query: Identify one actual source identity/version and mode plus actor/provider, class-level/rank, extras/metamagic choices, actual position/time/environment and contemplated real permissions. Own context is authorized; foreign private actor context needs actual informed cooperation. Public identified spell cost may be queried hypothetically without learning its formula or acquiring access. Missing operative source/rank/context operands returns unresolved, not an invented number. Distinguish no RP interface, exact0, known positive but unaffordable, and illegal casting with separately computable hypothetical price.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_quote: At query resolution snapshot the specified current context. Return exact ordinary total after real class/minima, this Matrix waiver, Nexus, Dampening and final Influence; separately show actual protected RP principal/other costs and legality/affordability only where requester already has authorized personal/cooperative pool knowledge. Include Ready history as already paid with0new release fee. No casting, reservation, Influence consumption, use expenditure, Dissonance or prospective concentration transition occurs; hypothetical new concentration prices from the predicted post-transition state. Quote is not future lock: later movement, strain or interruption requires new actual price.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_information: Reveal useful total including otherwise hidden applicable cost adjustments when the actual context is authorized; no modifier count/name/location/caster-currentRP/private repertoire/formula follows from a total. Independently genuine information defenses apply only to their real scope. If they make the requested total unreadable/unresolved, use the same neutral “No determinate quote in this context” without exposing protection existence/counts. Preserve independently authorized separate inquiries. Missing history is not0cost. Actual antimagic can suppress Mastery; pending Mind Blank is not assumed acquired or operational. No divination comparison becomes a global privacy rule.
